datacite.title: A Software Citation Primer
datacite.abstract:
A poster at RDA VP16:

Software is as integral as a research paper or dataset for facilitating the full understanding and dissemination of research. The FORCE11 Software Citation Implementation WG journals task force, with representatives from major scholarly publishers, has written an article to provide broadly applicable guidance on software citation for communities & institutions publishing journals & proceedings. The article also includes brief instructions on how software can be made citable.
